seeds.title: branches.py: load_format reports a NUL in the repo path as invalid JSON
seeds.detail: An in-process caller that passes a repo path with a NUL gets Fail with '<path> is not valid JSON: ValueError: embedded null byte'. The file is never read, so the message names the wrong cause. The CLI cannot receive a NUL in argv. Catch the path error before the JSON parse, or word the message by cause.

seeds.title: branches.py: a config.json with an integer over 4300 digits is refused
seeds.detail: Valid JSON with a 5000-digit integer in any key makes load_format raise Fail (Python int digits limit, ValueError). The branchFormat key is valid, but the whole config is refused. This is an unlikely config; record it for the bar raiser.
